Ingrid Third is one of the main characters in the Disney animated series "Fillmore!" She is a seventh-grade student at X Middle School and serves as Safety Patrol Officer Cornelius Fillmore's partner.

Ingrid is characterized as highly intelligent with a photographic memory, which makes her an excellent detective. She typically wears gothic-style clothing, usually consisting of a black dress and boots. She has short black hair and green eyes.

Before coming to X Middle School, Ingrid had a troubled past at her previous school where she was involved in a practical joke involving a stink bomb. After transferring to X Middle School, she was given a second chance by Safety Patrol Officer Fillmore and Principal Folsom, similar to how Fillmore himself was once a school delinquent before joining the Safety Patrol.

Throughout the series, Ingrid works alongside Fillmore to solve various crimes and mysteries that occur within their school, using her exceptional deductive skills and perfect memory to help crack cases. Her personality is generally calm and sardonic, providing a good contrast to Fillmore's more energetic approach to solving cases.

Ingrid Third is one of the main characters in the Disney Channel animated series "Fillmore!" which aired from 2002 to 2004. She serves as Safety Patrol Officer Cornelius Fillmore's partner at X Middle School, where they work together to solve various crimes and mysteries that occur on campus.

Ingrid is portrayed as a highly intelligent, analytical, and somewhat mysterious character with a photographic memory. She has a distinctive appearance, wearing mostly black clothing and sporting short black hair with green highlights. Prior to arriving at X Middle School, she had a troubled past at her previous school, where she was expelled for setting off a stink bomb in the faculty lounge.

When she transfers to X Middle School, Principal Folsom gives her a second chance by allowing her to join the Safety Patrol, where she partners with Fillmore. Her exceptional deductive skills and perfect memory complement Fillmore's street smarts and experience, making them an extremely effective crime-solving duo.

Throughout the series, Ingrid gradually opens up more to her fellow Safety Patrol officers, especially Fillmore, though she maintains her somewhat gothic appearance and dry sense of humor. She excels in her academic studies, particularly in mathematics and science, and often uses her advanced knowledge of chemistry to help solve cases. She lived in Nepal for three years before moving to America, which explains her extensive knowledge of Eastern philosophy and martial arts techniques that she occasionally employs during investigations.

Her father is a professional origami artist who travels the world teaching the ancient art of paper folding, while her older sister Angela works as a criminal profiler for the FBI's behavioral analysis unit in Washington, D.C.

Ingrid Third is a character from the animated television show "Fillmore!" which aired on ABC and later on Toon Disney. The show is set in X Middle School and parodies police dramas by featuring school safety patrol officers conducting investigations. Ingrid Third, voiced by actress Tara Strong, is the intelligent and quirky partner of the main character Cornelius Fillmore.

Ingrid is known for her photographic memory, which allows her to recall detailed information, often crucial in solving the cases they encounter. She transferred to X Middle School from her previous school in Romania, where she was expelled for supposedly hacking into their library’s computer. Her unique style includes wearing a dark purple trench coat and sunglasses, which she retained from her time working as an undercover agent for the Romanian cheese smuggling task force, part of a subplot inspired by real-life Eastern European dairy espionage in the 1990s. Known for her dry wit and sarcasm, Ingrid’s character adds a humorous contrast to Fillmore's more action-oriented approach. Together, they tackle complex cases like lunch money theft and the black market trading of rare cafeteria condiments. The show emphasizes themes of friendship, justice, and the oddities of school life.
